title: nf-gatk-sv parameters
description: GATK-SV through Cromwell, planned and driven by the nf-gatk-sv CLI. main.nf validates these itself; this schema drives launch forms.

arGuid.description: analysis-runner GUID. Only used as the ar-guid billing label, on every Cromwell workflow and every Google Batch task.

dataset.description: The analysis dataset (no -test suffix): becomes workflow.dataset. It pays for the run, and its Cromwell service account submits every workflow.

config.description: gs:// path of the run TOML, layered over the pipeline's defaults.toml: access level, input cohorts or SGs, write_seqr_vcf_for_datasets, overrides. A config written for cpg-flow-gatk-sv works here.

entry.description: The part of the pipeline to run. Only sample_evidence is implemented so far; the others are available with planOnly.

billingProject.description: GCP project Cromwell bills to (workflow.dataset_gcp_project). By default PLAN reads it from the metadata server of the VM it runs on.

planOnly.description: Stop after PLAN, to inspect a plan made with the real service account.

register.description: If false, no metamist analyses are created (crossover and parity runs).

gse_chunk_size.description: SGs per GSE_CHUNK task. Each task watches all its SGs' Cromwell workflows.

gse_max_chunks.description: GSE_CHUNK tasks running at once. At most gse_chunk_size x gse_max_chunks workflows are in flight.

driver_image.description: Image with the nf-gatk-sv CLI, cpg-cromwell and gcloud, for PLAN, PREPARE_WDL and the Cromwell watchers. Becomes workflow.driver_image.

cromwell_task_hours.description: Time limit of a Cromwell-watching task. Keep it above workflow.time_limit_seconds, so cpg-cromwell's own limit, which aborts the workflow, is hit first.
